requirement.description: The text_string function has issues with handling certain Unicode characters and encoding formats. Specifically, it fails to correctly process Euro sign (€) in literal PDFDocEncoded strings and doesn't properly handle UTF-16BE encoded strings with proper byte order marking.
requirement.contract: Function should correctly decode PDF text strings in both literal and hexadecimal formats, properly handling Unicode characters like Euro sign (€) and UTF-16BE encoded strings with byte order marks.

requirement.description: The next_token function has issues with stream token detection and handling of incomplete tokens, particularly in stream processing and handling of edge cases like incomplete streams or comments.
requirement.contract: Function should properly detect and tokenize stream objects, handle incomplete streams gracefully, and correctly process various token types including comments and hexadecimal strings.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with correctly handling references and parsing complex nested structures. It fails to properly process arrays and dictionaries with comments in them.
requirement.contract: Function should correctly parse PDF objects including arrays, dictionaries, and references while properly handling comments within structures.

requirement.description: The next_token function doesn't correctly handle the case where a token is incomplete at the end of the input, which causes some tests to fail.
requirement.contract: Function should return appropriate token types and positions for incomplete tokens at the end of input, including handling of comments and values.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function lacks proper handling of missing sample PDF files required for several tests, causing setup failures.
requirement.contract: Function should gracefully handle missing sample files during test setup, though this is more of a test environment issue than a core functionality issue.
